meaning:
(Pael) to hide, remove from sight
Aramaic of sa.tar (סָתַר "to hide" H5641)

elsewhere.note: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this…
He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
